messages:
Maya: Heads-up — courier in the lobby with a potted fiddle leaf fig labeled for the 4pm client meeting. Front Desk says it's fragile. Any recommended temporary spot that won't block the walkway? Also the visitor will need a temp badge and an outlet near Meeting B.
Front Desk: We can hold it at the concierge desk but it's tight. Temp badge is ready, we just need the visitor's full name. There's a wall outlet in Meeting B but it's behind a tall cabinet; might need a power strip.
Sam: If it's fragile, can we put it on the low credenza in Meeting B (against the window)? Not ideal for foot traffic but better than lobby. I can move the cabinet over and free the outlet.
Ilana: I can meet the courier and grab the badge details — name is "Jordan Park" per delivery tag. I'll be there in 5.
Leo: Quick note — custodial flagged the credenza for water marks before. Maybe box a sheet under the pot and put the plant on a tray. I have a spare tray in storage.
Maya: Perfect. @Front Desk can you hand Ilana the temp badge when she arrives? Also add a sticky note on the pot: "Fragile — Client Visit 4pm" :package: :seedling:
Front Desk: Got it. Badge printed for Jordan Park; will hand to Ilana. We'll move the plant to Meeting B on a tray, leave a note, and plug into the outlet with a short extension.
frontdesk-bot: Visitor check-in: Jordan Park — badge issued at 03:20pm by Front Desk.
Sam: Thanks team. One last thing — Jordan said they might bring a small suitcase. If it lands, can we put it under the long table in Meeting B? Not blocking doors.
Ilana: Yep, will stash the suitcase under the table and put the plant in the corner tray. See you at 3:55 for quick setup.
Maya: Appreciate the quick reactions. :thumbsup:
